description: A fungal infection is a skin condition caused by fungi that thrive in warm, moist areas of the body. It commonly affects the skin folds, feet, or scalp and is usually not serious but can be persistent.
symptoms: Itching, skin rash, redness, scaling, discoloration of skin, patches with clear edges
causes: Excess sweating, poor hygiene, warm and humid climate, tight clothing, weakened immunity
treatment: Keep the area clean and dry, use antifungal creams or powders, avoid sharing personal items
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Clotrimazole, Terbinafine, Fluconazole, under medical supervision.
precautions: Wear loose breathable clothing, keep skin dry, avoid sharing towels or footwear, maintain good hygiene
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Infection spreads rapidly, Severe swelling occurs, Signs of pus or fever develop

description: An allergy is an abnormal immune reaction to a substance that is normally harmless, such as pollen, dust, or certain foods. Symptoms can range from mild irritation to severe reactions depending on the trigger.
symptoms: Sneezing, runny nose, itchy eyes, skin rash, hives, watery eyes
causes: Exposure to allergens such as pollen, dust mites, pet dander, certain foods, or medications
treatment: Avoid known allergens, use antihistamines, keep living areas clean, consult a doctor for persistent symptoms
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Cetirizine, Loratadine, Antihistamine nasal sprays, under medical supervision.
precautions: Avoid known triggers, keep windows closed during high pollen season, use air purifiers, wash hands frequently
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Difficulty breathing occurs, Swelling of face or throat, Severe dizziness or fainting

description: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) is a digestive disorder where stomach acid frequently flows back into the esophagus, causing irritation. It is a common chronic condition that can be managed with lifestyle changes and medication.
symptoms: Heartburn, acid regurgitation, chest discomfort, difficulty swallowing, chronic cough
causes: Weak lower esophageal sphincter, obesity, smoking, spicy or fatty food, overeating, lying down after meals
treatment: Lifestyle modification, dietary changes, avoiding trigger foods, elevating head while sleeping, medication if needed
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Omeprazole, Ranitidine, Antacids, under medical supervision.
precautions: Avoid spicy and fatty foods, eat smaller meals, avoid lying down right after eating, reduce caffeine and alcohol
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Chest pain becomes severe, Difficulty swallowing worsens, Vomiting blood occurs

description: Chronic cholestasis is a long-term condition where the flow of bile from the liver is reduced or blocked, leading to accumulation of bile substances in the body. This can cause skin and eye yellowing along with itching.
symptoms: Itching, jaundice, dark urine, pale stools, fatigue, abdominal discomfort
causes: Liver disease, bile duct obstruction, certain medications, autoimmune liver conditions
treatment: Treat underlying cause, medications to relieve itching, dietary adjustments, regular liver function monitoring
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Ursodeoxycholic acid, Cholestyramine, under medical supervision.
precautions: Avoid alcohol, maintain a balanced diet, attend regular liver checkups, avoid hepatotoxic drugs
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe abdominal pain occurs, Confusion or altered consciousness, Signs of bleeding appear

description: A drug reaction is an unwanted or harmful response of the body to a medication. Reactions can range from mild skin rashes to severe life-threatening allergic responses.
symptoms: Skin rash, itching, swelling, fever, nausea, breathing difficulty
causes: Allergic response to medication, drug overdose, drug interactions, individual sensitivity
treatment: Stop the suspected drug immediately, seek medical advice, supportive treatment for symptoms
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Antihistamines, Corticosteroids, under medical supervision.
precautions: Inform doctors of known allergies, avoid self-medication, carry a list of drug allergies, read medication labels carefully
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Difficulty breathing occurs, Facial or throat swelling, Widespread skin blistering

description: Peptic ulcer disease involves open sores that develop on the inner lining of the stomach or upper small intestine. It is often caused by bacterial infection or long-term use of certain pain medications.
symptoms: Abdominal pain, bloating, nausea, indigestion, dark stools
causes: Helicobacter pylori infection, long-term NSAID use, excessive alcohol, smoking, stress
treatment: Antibiotics if infection present, acid-reducing medication, dietary changes, avoiding NSAIDs
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Omeprazole, Amoxicillin, Clarithromycin, under medical supervision.
precautions: Avoid NSAIDs, limit alcohol and smoking, eat regular balanced meals, manage stress
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Vomiting blood occurs, Black tarry stools appear, Severe abdominal pain develops suddenly

description: Acquired Immunodeficiency Syndrome (AIDS) is an advanced stage of HIV infection that severely damages the immune system, making the body vulnerable to infections and certain cancers. It is a chronic condition managed with lifelong antiretroviral therapy.
symptoms: Recurrent infections, significant weight loss, chronic fatigue, prolonged fever, night sweats, swollen lymph nodes
causes: HIV infection through unprotected sex, contaminated needles, blood transfusion, mother-to-child transmission
treatment: Antiretroviral therapy, treatment of opportunistic infections, regular immune monitoring, nutritional support
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Antiretroviral drugs such as Tenofovir, Lamivudine, Efavirenz, under medical supervision.
precautions: Practice safe sex, avoid sharing needles, regular health screening, adhere strictly to prescribed therapy
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe difficulty breathing, High persistent fever, Signs of severe infection appear

description: Diabetes is a chronic metabolic disorder in which the body cannot properly regulate blood sugar levels due to insufficient insulin production or insulin resistance. It requires ongoing management through diet, exercise, and medication.
symptoms: Increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, blurred vision, slow wound healing
causes: Insulin resistance, genetic factors, obesity, sedentary lifestyle, poor diet
treatment: Blood sugar monitoring, dietary management, regular exercise, medication or insulin therapy as prescribed
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Metformin, Insulin, Glimepiride, under medical supervision.
precautions: Maintain healthy diet, exercise regularly, monitor blood sugar levels, avoid excessive sugar intake
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Confusion or loss of consciousness, Very high or very low blood sugar symptoms, Severe dehydration occurs

description: Gastroenteritis is an inflammation of the stomach and intestines, commonly known as stomach flu, usually caused by viral or bacterial infection. It typically resolves on its own with proper hydration and rest.
symptoms: Diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal cramps, nausea, mild fever
causes: Viral or bacterial infection, contaminated food or water, poor hygiene
treatment: Oral rehydration, rest, bland diet, medication for symptom relief if needed
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Oral rehydration salts, Ondansetron for nausea, under medical supervision.
precautions: Wash hands frequently, drink clean water, avoid contaminated food, maintain proper hygiene
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Signs of severe dehydration appear, Blood in stool or vomit, High fever persists

description: Bronchial asthma is a chronic respiratory condition where the airways become inflamed and narrowed, leading to difficulty breathing. It is often triggered by allergens, exercise, or respiratory infections.
symptoms: Wheezing, shortness of breath, chest tightness, coughing, especially at night
causes: Allergens, air pollution, respiratory infections, genetic predisposition, cold air
treatment: Avoid triggers, use inhalers as prescribed, regular monitoring of lung function
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Salbutamol inhaler, Budesonide inhaler, under medical supervision.
precautions: Avoid known triggers, keep inhaler accessible, avoid smoking, get flu vaccinations
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe difficulty breathing, Lips or face turn bluish, Inhaler provides no relief

description: Hypertension, or high blood pressure, is a long-term condition where the force of blood against artery walls remains consistently elevated. It often has no symptoms but increases risk of heart disease and stroke.
symptoms: Often asymptomatic, headache, dizziness, blurred vision, chest discomfort in severe cases
causes: Genetics, high salt intake, obesity, stress, sedentary lifestyle, smoking
treatment: Lifestyle modification, regular blood pressure monitoring, medication as prescribed, dietary changes
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Amlodipine, Losartan, Atenolol, under medical supervision.
precautions: Reduce salt intake, exercise regularly, manage stress, avoid smoking and alcohol
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe headache with vision changes, Chest pain occurs, Blood pressure reading is extremely high

description: A migraine is a neurological condition causing recurrent, often severe headaches usually accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light or sound. Episodes can last from hours to days.
symptoms: Throbbing headache, nausea, sensitivity to light and sound, visual disturbances
causes: Genetic factors, hormonal changes, stress, certain foods, lack of sleep
treatment: Rest in a dark quiet room, pain relief medication, identifying and avoiding triggers, preventive medication if frequent
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Ibuprofen, Sumatriptan, Paracetamol, under medical supervision.
precautions: Maintain regular sleep schedule, avoid known triggers, manage stress, stay hydrated
estimatedRecoveryTime: Few hours to 2-3 days per episode
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Sudden severe headache unlike usual pattern, Vision loss occurs, Weakness or confusion develops

description: Cervical spondylosis is a degenerative condition affecting the bones and discs of the neck due to age-related wear and tear. It commonly causes neck stiffness and pain, especially in older adults.
symptoms: Neck pain and stiffness, headache, shoulder pain, numbness in arms
causes: Age-related disc degeneration, poor posture, previous neck injury, repetitive strain
treatment: Physical therapy, pain relief medication, neck exercises, posture correction
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Paracetamol, Ibuprofen, Muscle relaxants, under medical supervision.
precautions: Maintain proper posture, take breaks during prolonged desk work, do neck exercises, use supportive pillows
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Sudden weakness in limbs, Loss of bladder or bowel control, Severe unrelenting pain

description: Paralysis due to brain hemorrhage occurs when bleeding within the brain damages areas controlling movement, leading to loss of muscle function on one or both sides of the body. It is a medical emergency requiring immediate treatment.
symptoms: Sudden weakness or numbness, difficulty speaking, loss of coordination, severe headache, vision problems
causes: High blood pressure, head trauma, aneurysm rupture, blood clotting disorders
treatment: Emergency hospitalization, surgery if needed, rehabilitation therapy, long-term physical therapy
medicines: Managed strictly by hospital care team under medical supervision
precautions: Control blood pressure, avoid head injuries, regular health checkups, avoid smoking and excessive alcohol
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Sudden weakness or numbness occurs, Slurred speech develops, Severe headache with vomiting

description: Jaundice is a condition characterized by yellowing of the skin and eyes due to elevated bilirubin levels in the blood, often resulting from liver dysfunction. Its severity depends on the underlying cause.
symptoms: Yellowing of skin and eyes, dark urine, fatigue, abdominal pain, pale stools
causes: Liver disease, bile duct obstruction, hemolysis, viral hepatitis
treatment: Treat underlying cause, rest, hydration, dietary adjustments, avoid alcohol
medicines: Managed based on underlying cause under medical supervision
precautions: Avoid alcohol, maintain hygiene, eat a balanced diet, get vaccinated against hepatitis
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe abdominal pain occurs, Confusion develops, High fever persists

description: Malaria is a mosquito-borne infectious disease caused by parasites transmitted through the bite of infected Anopheles mosquitoes. It causes recurring fever cycles and can be severe if untreated.
symptoms: High fever with chills, sweating, headache, muscle pain, fatigue, nausea
causes: Infection by Plasmodium parasite through mosquito bite
treatment: Antimalarial medication, rest, hydration, hospitalization in severe cases
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Chloroquine, Artemisinin-based combination therapy, under medical supervision.
precautions: Use mosquito nets, apply insect repellent, eliminate stagnant water, use protective clothing
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: High persistent fever occurs, Confusion or seizures develop, Difficulty breathing appears

description: Chicken pox is a highly contagious viral infection causing an itchy blister-like rash all over the body. It is common in children but can affect adults with more severe symptoms.
symptoms: Itchy rash with fluid-filled blisters, fever, fatigue, loss of appetite
causes: Varicella-zoster virus infection spread through air or contact
treatment: Rest, hydration, symptomatic relief, antiviral medication in severe cases, isolation to prevent spread
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Calamine lotion, Paracetamol, Acyclovir in severe cases, under medical supervision.
precautions: Isolate from others, avoid scratching, maintain hygiene, get vaccinated
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: High persistent fever occurs, Difficulty breathing develops, Signs of skin infection appear

description: Dengue is a mosquito-borne viral infection that causes flu-like illness and can progress to severe complications in some cases. It is transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes and is common in tropical regions.
symptoms: High fever, severe headache, joint and muscle pain, rash, nausea, fatigue
causes: Infection by dengue virus through Aedes mosquito bite
treatment: Rest, hydration, fever and pain management, hospitalization for severe cases
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Paracetamol for fever, avoid NSAIDs, under medical supervision.
precautions: Use mosquito repellent, eliminate stagnant water, wear protective clothing, use mosquito nets
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe abdominal pain occurs, Bleeding from gums or nose, Persistent vomiting develops

description: Typhoid fever is a bacterial infection caused by contaminated food or water, leading to prolonged fever and gastrointestinal symptoms. Early treatment with antibiotics leads to good recovery.
symptoms: Prolonged high fever, weakness, abdominal pain, headache, loss of appetite
causes: Salmonella typhi bacterial infection through contaminated food or water
treatment: Antibiotic therapy, rest, hydration, dietary management
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Ciprofloxacin, Azithromycin, Ceftriaxone, under medical supervision.
precautions: Drink clean water, maintain food hygiene, wash hands frequently, get vaccinated
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe abdominal pain occurs, Confusion develops, Signs of intestinal bleeding appear

description: Hepatitis A is a viral liver infection usually spread through contaminated food or water. It generally resolves on its own without long-term liver damage.
symptoms: Fatigue, nausea, abdominal discomfort, jaundice, loss of appetite
causes: Hepatitis A virus infection through contaminated food or water
treatment: Rest, hydration, dietary management, avoid alcohol
medicines: Managed with supportive care under medical supervision
precautions: Practice good hygiene, drink clean water, get vaccinated, avoid contaminated food
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe abdominal pain occurs, Confusion develops, Persistent vomiting appears

description: Hepatitis B is a viral infection that affects the liver and can become chronic, leading to long-term liver damage if untreated. It spreads through contact with infected blood or bodily fluids.
symptoms: Fatigue, jaundice, abdominal pain, dark urine, joint pain
causes: Hepatitis B virus transmitted through blood, unprotected sex, or mother-to-child transmission
treatment: Antiviral medication for chronic cases, regular liver monitoring, supportive care
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Tenofovir, Entecavir, under medical supervision.
precautions: Get vaccinated, avoid sharing needles, practice safe sex, regular liver checkups
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe abdominal pain occurs, Confusion develops, Signs of bleeding appear

description: Hepatitis C is a viral infection that primarily affects the liver and can lead to chronic liver disease if not treated. It spreads mainly through contact with infected blood.
symptoms: Fatigue, jaundice, joint pain, abdominal discomfort, dark urine
causes: Hepatitis C virus transmitted through blood contact, needle sharing
treatment: Antiviral therapy, regular liver function monitoring, lifestyle changes
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Sofosbuvir, Daclatasvir, under medical supervision.
precautions: Avoid sharing needles, practice safe sex, regular health screening, avoid alcohol
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe abdominal pain occurs, Confusion develops, Signs of bleeding appear

description: Hepatitis D is a liver infection that only occurs in people already infected with Hepatitis B, often worsening liver damage. It requires careful monitoring and management of both infections.
symptoms: Fatigue, jaundice, abdominal pain, dark urine, joint pain
causes: Hepatitis D virus infection occurring alongside Hepatitis B infection
treatment: Antiviral therapy, management of Hepatitis B, regular liver monitoring
medicines: Managed under specialist care with medical supervision
precautions: Get vaccinated against Hepatitis B, avoid needle sharing, practice safe sex, regular checkups
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe abdominal pain occurs, Confusion develops, Signs of bleeding appear

description: Hepatitis E is a viral liver infection typically spread through contaminated water, usually causing a self-limiting illness. It can be more serious in pregnant women.
symptoms: Fatigue, jaundice, nausea, abdominal pain, loss of appetite
causes: Hepatitis E virus infection through contaminated water
treatment: Rest, hydration, dietary management, supportive care
medicines: Managed with supportive care under medical supervision
precautions: Drink clean water, maintain hygiene, avoid contaminated food, especially important during pregnancy
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe abdominal pain occurs, Confusion develops, Persistent vomiting appears

description: Tuberculosis is a bacterial infection that primarily affects the lungs and spreads through airborne droplets. It requires a prolonged course of antibiotics for complete treatment.
symptoms: Persistent cough, weight loss, night sweats, fever, fatigue, coughing up blood
causes: Mycobacterium tuberculosis bacterial infection spread through air
treatment: Long-term antibiotic therapy, regular monitoring, nutritional support
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Isoniazid, Rifampicin, Ethambutol, Pyrazinamide, under medical supervision.

emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Coughing up significant blood, Severe difficulty breathing, High persistent fever

description: The common cold is a mild viral infection of the upper respiratory tract, causing nasal congestion and throat irritation. It usually resolves on its own within a week.
symptoms: Runny nose, sneezing, sore throat, mild cough, congestion
causes: Viral infection, commonly rhinovirus, spread through droplets or contact
treatment: Rest, hydration, symptomatic relief, steam inhalation
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Paracetamol, Antihistamines, Decongestants, under medical supervision.
precautions: Wash hands frequently, avoid close contact with sick individuals, maintain hydration, cover mouth while sneezing
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: High fever persists beyond a few days, Difficulty breathing occurs, Symptoms worsen significantly

description: Pneumonia is an infection that inflames the air sacs in one or both lungs, which may fill with fluid, causing breathing difficulty. It can be caused by bacteria, viruses, or fungi.
symptoms: Cough with phlegm, fever, chills, difficulty breathing, chest pain
causes: Bacterial, viral, or fungal infection of the lungs
treatment: Antibiotics for bacterial cases, rest, hydration, oxygen therapy if needed
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Amoxicillin, Azithromycin, under medical supervision.
precautions: Get vaccinated, avoid smoking, maintain good hygiene, avoid close contact with sick individuals
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe difficulty breathing, Bluish lips or face, High persistent fever

description: Dimorphic hemorrhoids, commonly known as piles, are swollen veins in the lower rectum and anus causing discomfort and bleeding. They are often related to straining during bowel movements.
symptoms: Rectal bleeding, pain during bowel movements, itching, swelling near anus
causes: Straining during bowel movements, chronic constipation, pregnancy, prolonged sitting
treatment: Dietary fiber increase, hydration, topical treatments, surgery in severe cases
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Topical hemorrhoid creams, stool softeners, under medical supervision.
precautions: Increase fiber intake, stay hydrated, avoid straining, exercise regularly
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Heavy rectal bleeding occurs, Severe pain develops, Signs of infection appear

description: A heart attack occurs when blood flow to a part of the heart is blocked, causing damage to the heart muscle. It is a medical emergency requiring immediate treatment to minimize damage.
symptoms: Chest pain or pressure, shortness of breath, pain radiating to arm or jaw, sweating, nausea
causes: Blocked coronary artery, atherosclerosis, high cholesterol, smoking, hypertension
treatment: Emergency medical treatment, medication, possible surgery, cardiac rehabilitation
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Aspirin, Nitroglycerin, Clot-dissolving drugs, under medical supervision.
precautions: Manage cholesterol and blood pressure, avoid smoking, exercise regularly, maintain healthy diet
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Chest pain becomes severe, Pain radiates to arm or jaw, Shortness of breath develops suddenly

description: Varicose veins are enlarged, twisted veins usually appearing in the legs due to weakened vein valves. While often a cosmetic concern, they can cause discomfort in some cases.
symptoms: Swollen visible veins, leg pain, heaviness, swelling, itching around veins
causes: Weak vein valves, prolonged standing, obesity, pregnancy, genetic factors
treatment: Compression stockings, leg elevation, exercise, surgical procedures in severe cases
medicines: Managed with lifestyle measures and procedures under medical supervision
precautions: Avoid prolonged standing, elevate legs, exercise regularly, maintain healthy weight
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Sudden severe leg swelling, Skin ulcers develop, Signs of blood clot appear

description: Hypothyroidism is a condition in which the thyroid gland does not produce enough thyroid hormone, slowing down the body's metabolism. It requires long-term hormone replacement therapy.
symptoms: Fatigue, weight gain, cold intolerance, dry skin, hair thinning, depression
causes: Autoimmune thyroiditis, iodine deficiency, thyroid surgery, certain medications

medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Levothyroxine, under medical supervision.
precautions: Take medication consistently, regular thyroid function tests, maintain balanced diet with adequate iodine
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe fatigue with confusion, Difficulty breathing, Very low body temperature occurs

description: Hyperthyroidism occurs when the thyroid gland produces excessive thyroid hormone, speeding up the body's metabolism. It can lead to various symptoms affecting heart rate and weight.

causes: Graves disease, thyroid nodules, excessive iodine intake, thyroiditis
treatment: Antithyroid medication, radioactive iodine therapy, surgery in some cases
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Methimazole, Propranolol, under medical supervision.

emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Rapid heartbeat with chest pain, Severe agitation or confusion, High fever develops

description: Hypoglycemia is a condition characterized by abnormally low blood sugar levels, often occurring in people with diabetes on medication. It requires prompt treatment to restore normal glucose levels.

precautions: Eat regular meals, monitor blood sugar levels, carry fast-acting sugar source, adjust medication as advised
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Loss of consciousness occurs, Seizures develop, Symptoms do not improve after sugar intake

description: Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease caused by the breakdown of cartilage, leading to pain and stiffness, most commonly in weight-bearing joints. It is more common with aging.

causes: Age-related wear and tear, joint injury, obesity, repetitive stress on joints
treatment: Pain management, physical therapy, weight management, joint replacement surgery in severe cases
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Paracetamol, Ibuprofen, under medical supervision.
precautions: Maintain healthy weight, exercise regularly, avoid repetitive joint strain, use joint support if needed
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Sudden severe joint pain, Joint becomes red and hot, Inability to move the joint

description: Arthritis refers to inflammation of one or more joints, causing pain and stiffness that can worsen with age. There are various types, with rheumatoid and osteoarthritis being most common.

causes: Autoimmune conditions, joint wear and tear, infections, genetic factors
treatment: Anti-inflammatory medication, physical therapy, lifestyle modification, disease-modifying drugs for autoimmune types
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Ibuprofen, Methotrexate for autoimmune types, under medical supervision.
precautions: Exercise regularly, maintain healthy weight, protect joints from strain, follow prescribed treatment
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Sudden severe joint swelling, High fever with joint pain, Inability to move affected joint

description: Acne is a common skin condition caused by clogged hair follicles due to oil and dead skin cells, leading to pimples and blemishes. It commonly affects the face, chest, and back.
symptoms: Pimples, blackheads, whiteheads, oily skin, occasional scarring
causes: Excess oil production, clogged pores, hormonal changes, bacteria, genetics
treatment: Topical treatments, oral medication for severe cases, proper skin care routine
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Benzoyl peroxide, Salicylic acid, Isotretinoin in severe cases, under medical supervision.

emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Severe painful cystic acne develops, Signs of skin infection appear, No improvement with treatment

description: A urinary tract infection is a bacterial infection affecting any part of the urinary system, most commonly the bladder and urethra. It is more common in women and usually treatable with antibiotics.

causes: Bacterial infection, poor hygiene, holding urine for long periods, sexual activity
treatment: Antibiotic therapy, increased fluid intake, pain relief medication

precautions: Stay hydrated, maintain proper hygiene, urinate after sexual activity, avoid holding urine for long periods
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: High fever with back pain, Blood in urine, Symptoms worsen despite treatment

description: Psoriasis is a chronic autoimmune skin condition that causes rapid buildup of skin cells, resulting in scaly, itchy patches. It is a long-term condition with periods of flare-ups and remission.

causes: Autoimmune dysfunction, genetic factors, stress, skin injury, infections
treatment: Topical treatments, phototherapy, systemic medication for severe cases, moisturizing skin regularly
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Corticosteroid creams, Methotrexate for severe cases, under medical supervision.
precautions: Moisturize skin regularly, avoid known triggers, manage stress, avoid skin injury
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Widespread severe skin involvement, Signs of skin infection, Joint pain becomes severe

description: Impetigo is a highly contagious bacterial skin infection common in children, causing red sores that can rupture and form honey-colored crusts. It spreads easily through direct contact.

causes: Bacterial infection from Staphylococcus or Streptococcus, skin injury, close contact with infected person
treatment: Topical or oral antibiotics, keeping affected area clean, avoiding scratching
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Mupirocin, Cephalexin, under medical supervision.
precautions: Maintain good hygiene, avoid sharing personal items, keep sores covered, wash hands frequently
emergencyWarning: Seek immediate medical attention if: Infection spreads rapidly, High fever develops, Signs of deeper skin infection appear

causes: Inner ear disorders, vestibular problems, migraines, certain medications

estimatedRecoveryTime: Days to weeks depending on cause

causes: Long-term excessive alcohol consumption, malnutrition, chronic liver damage
treatment: Complete alcohol cessation, nutritional support, medication for inflammation, liver monitoring
medicines: Commonly used medicines may include Corticosteroids in severe cases, under medical supervision.

estimatedRecoveryTime: Weeks to months, varies with severity
